description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Money Broking Regulations No. 1 of 2016 that shall be come into effect from 01.06.2016
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Monetary Board of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka under the Monetary Law Act, specifically amending the Money Broking Regulations. It deals with legal/regulatory framework changes for financial operations, falling under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for regulatory matters and statutory instruments.
